title: Adopt mdatron 0.4.0 (envelope 2.0.0, breaking) — bump pins + re-verify
description:
mdatron 0.4.0 shipped (first normal release; envelope mdatron_output_version 1.1.0 -> 2.0.0, breaking). Operator directive: adopt ASAP; also gates mdatron's crates.io publish (held pending vsdd-cli clear-to-publish).

Consumer-facing breaking changes: families reshaped bare-string -> {state, reason}; quoted[] gained required origin/trusted; verify --json no longer re-emits findings on stderr (stdout envelope authoritative). Wins: summary.files_checked now = files VALIDATED (the non-vacuity fix); E0080 -> pipeline_error.kind; new W0045/W0046/W0047; my relayed [see: <label>] interpolation ruling shipped.

vsdd-cli adoption scope (assessed): (1) bump pins v0.3.0 -> v0.4.0 in .github/workflows/{mdatron-verify,vsdd-test}.yml + .githooks/pre-commit MIN_VERSION; (2) re-verify vsdd's own codes (VSDD-E0207/E0208, MDATRON-W0040) still fire under 0.4.0 — cross_references.rs + jurisdiction_nonvacuity.rs parse only findings[].code + pipeline_status (untyped Value, stable fields), so no parse break expected, but empirical re-run required; (3) fix a stale files_checked comment in jurisdiction_nonvacuity.rs.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: mdatron 0.4.0 adopted + committed on branch adopt-mdatron-0.4.0 (off main). Pins bumped (both CI legs + pre-commit); superseded prose (DESIGN-*.md, methodology.md) dropped from jurisdiction in response to the new W0045; verify clean (0 findings, files_checked 79); all workspace tests green. The verification-engine change was absorbed safely — the protections held (non-vacuity canary W0040 fires, positive-controls E0207/E0208 + pipeline_status ok). Feedback + clear-to-publish filed to mdatron GitHub issue #1 (label from:vsdd-cli), covering: the protection-test result, the confirmed files_checked non-vacuity fix, the W0045 catch, consumer-resilience to the 2.0.0 envelope reshape, and answers to the two design calls (item 10 zero-match-sufficient / no recorded-baseline; item 2 empty-schemas gap is real, address as a warning). Awaits operator push + PR.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: merged to main via PR #8 (commit c94ba2e3). mdatron 0.4.0 adopted; main green. Adoption feedback + clear-to-publish at mdatron GitHub #1.
